sourcing_strategy: Prefer permission-cleared standalone MP3/OGG master files for offline inclusion. YouTube URLs are reference links only, not downloads. Do not add third-party recordings to shipped audio_catalog.json without verifying performance, lyrics, tune, recording owners, and permissions.
